messages:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — hosted-api queue 'deadtime' exceeded threshold. queue_depth=12,300; pending_evictions=912; p95_latency=9.2s p99_latency=21.8s; autoscaler_attempts=fail(3). Trigger=queue_deadtime>25s. Paging oncall.
Daniel: Acknowledged. @Priya you're oncall right? Please take.
Priya: I'm up — looking at provisioner and autoscaler logs now. Seeing repeated 'debounce timeout' in provisioner and then immediate eviction loop. Will paste logs.
Priya: ```
I0421 21:33:42 provisioner.go:412] scaleDecision: desired=24 current=12 action=scale_up
E0421 21:33:43 provisioner.go:437] scaleReject: reason=rate_limit window=60s max_scale_up=2
W0421 21:34:01 provisioner.go:522] debounce expired, retrying scale up
E0421 21:34:05 evictionmgr.go:88] eviction: pending=912; process_time=300ms
``` 
Priya: The provisioner is hitting a rate cap on API calls to the cloud provider and our internal debounce is long (120s). That plus the rate limit leads to repeated backlog and evictions. 
infra-ci: Noted — checking infra quotas in us-west-2. No obvious cloud quota error in account, but our provisioner client is being throttled (429s) by the allocator service. I'm pulling allocator logs.
infra-ci: ```
2025-04-21T21:33:40Z allocator-service WARN request_id=abc123 status=429 details="too many requests"
2025-04-21T21:33:44Z allocator-service INFO granted=0 node_pools_considered=3
``` 
Priya: Ok, so allocator throttling → provisioner can't create nodes quickly → queue builds. Two immediate mitigations: 1) reduce debounce/cooldown so provisioner retries faster with smaller increments; 2) enable temporary fallback routing to lower-cost CPU pool for low-priority traffic. Starting with (2) to reduce customer impact while we fix provisioner.
Ops-Router: Applying 10% spillover routing for non-SLA tenants to cpu-fallback-v2 now. Command:
Ops-Router: ```
POST /routing/update {"route":"cpu-fallback-v2","sample":0.10,"match":"tenant_priority<=low"}
``` 
Ops-Router: Update applied. Awaiting metrics.
Priya: Applying a temporary autoscaler tweak: set provisioner.debounce=30s and max_scale_up_per_cycle=4 via emergency flag. Pushing now (will auto-revert in 30m). Command:
Priya: ```
kubectl -n hosted set env deploy/provisioner PROVISIONER_DEBOUNCE=30s PROVISIONER_MAX_UP=4 --record
``` 
Daniel: Before we ramp that, what's the customer impact? @CustomerSuccess-Leah any reports?
CustomerSuccess-Leah: CS saw 3 enterprise customers report intermittent 504s starting 21:33, lasting roughly until 21:40. One reported p99 timeouts for embedding jobs; we opened support ticket SUP-3492. Triage: requests returned 504 or 502. Estimated affected requests ~1.8k.
Priya: Thanks. With spillover live those numbers should drop. I'm also enabling short-term token-bucket rate limit for anonymous/free tier to protect core tenants: set free_tier_qps=5.
Priya: ```
redis-cli HSET rate-limits free_tier_qps 5
``` 
infra-ci: After the debounce change, provisioner attempts succeeded: saw three node creations succeed within 90s. Cloud provider logs show low-level throttling cleared after 21:36 (allocator backed off). queue_depth dropped to ~3.2k by 21:38.
infra-ci: Logs snippet:
infra-ci: ```
I0421 21:36:12 provisioner.go:446] scaleSuccess: added=3 new_total=15
I0421 21:36:28 allocator-service INFO request_id=def456 granted=3
``` 
Priya: p95 down to 1.1s by 21:39, p99 around 4.8s — still above normal but acceptable for now. Customer 504 counts reduced to single-digit incidents. 
Daniel: Good. @Marcus please prepare to take primary for the post-incident follow-up. I'll keep the channel for final notes for 15m.
Marcus: Taking handoff at 21:45. Will open a follow-up ticket for deeper RCA and runbook updates. Noted actions: (A) add allocator vs provisioner backpressure metrics, (B) reduce default debounce, (C) emergency routing playbook.
CustomerSuccess-Leah: I'll sync with the three impacted customers and update SUP-3492 with mitigation timeline and apology note.
Priya: Creating follow-up artifacts: incident doc INC-2025-312 and short blast in #status. Tagging responsible owners: @infra-team, @router-team, @sre-automation.
Priya: ```
POST /incidents {"id":"INC-2025-312","summary":"allocator throttle caused provisioner debounce loop; temporary routing + debounce reduction mitigated impact","severity":"sev2","owner":"Marcus"}
``` 
SRE-Bot: Incident created INC-2025-312 — assigned to Marcus. :white_check_mark:
Marcus: Handoff accepted. I'll run the full RCA in the morning and schedule a 1hr runbook workshop. Leaving channel open for any remaining notes.
Daniel: Thanks everyone. Closing active mitigation. If anything reappears re-ping with :pager: and we'll re-open. 
CustomerSuccess-Leah: Posted customer updates and closed immediate support loops. :thumbsup:
Priya: Marking this thread for postmortem. Good catch on the deadtime metric, that threshold helped. I'll propose an alert tuning in the RCA. 
Marcus: Closing handoff at 21:46. Will circulate postmortem draft tomorrow.
